description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for managing client charges within the Fineract platform. It provides endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, paying, waiving, and deleting client charges, along with handling associated entities like transactions. The class leverages JAX-RS annotations for REST endpoints, Swagger annotations for documentation, and uses Fineract's internal services for business logic and serialization.

classes.name: ClientChargesApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class providing endpoints to manage client charges, including listing, retrieval, creation, payments, waivers, and deletion.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientCharges
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all client charges with optional filtering by status and pagination.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template with available charge options for creating a new client charge.

methods.name: retrieveClientCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific client charge, including optional associations like transactions.

methods.name: applyClientCharge
methods.description: Handles POST request to associate a new charge with a client.

methods.name: payOrWaiveClientCharge
methods.description: Handles POST request to pay, waive, or inactivate a specific client charge based on command parameter.

methods.name: deleteClientCharge
methods.description: Handles DELETE request to remove a client charge if no transactions are associated.
